notes: §2002:12.3.2 SR1 grants the input-output section in program, function, factory and instance definitions and bars it from method, class-outer and interface definitions: at --std 2002 the four permitted owners each write and read back their own file (FUNCTION=FUNC / PROGRAM=PROG / FACTORY=FACT / OBJECT=OBJT, per §2002:12.3.4.4.3 GR2a and §2002:8.4.5.1.1), and the three barred placements are each refused COBOL2644 alone.
